chapters.title: Chapter 6: The Brain is a Part of the Body

episode.tagline: Know thyself, goes an Ancient Greek exhortation. And yet, too many of us have little understand of how we are hardwired. To truly know ourselves, we must understand the processes of evolution: natural selection and sexual selection.
episode.about: In this episode, Amit and Ajay explain why understanding natural selection changed the way they look at the world.
